n: The last psalm credited to David, and an acrostic praising God as King. David will lift up God’s name forever.

f.w: extol
O king

n: Praise is not occasional: he will bless God every single day, forever.

f.w: Every day will I bless thee

n: The Lord is great and deserves great praise. His greatness can’t be fully explored.

f.w: his greatness is unsearchable

n: Each generation passes on the story of God’s mighty acts to the next — parents to children.

f.w: One generation shall praise thy works to another

n: He will reflect on the splendor of God’s majesty and his wonders.

f.w: the glorious honour of thy majesty

n: People will speak of God’s awe-inspiring deeds, and David will declare his greatness.

f.w: terrible acts

n: They will overflow with memories of God’s goodness and sing joyfully of his righteousness.

f.w: abundantly utter

n: This echoes God’s self-revelation to Moses: gracious, compassionate, slow to anger, and abounding in steadfast love.

f.w: slow to anger, and of great mercy

n: God is good to everyone, and his compassion covers all he has made.

f.w: The LORD is good to all

n: All creation praises God, and his faithful ones bless him.

f.w: All thy works shall praise thee
saints

n: The faithful talk of the glory of God’s kingdom and his power.

f.w: the glory of thy kingdom

n: Their purpose: to make God’s mighty acts and majestic kingdom known to all people.

f.w: To make known to the sons of men

n: God’s kingdom is everlasting, his rule unending.

f.w: an everlasting kingdom

n: The King lifts up all who fall and straightens those bent under burdens. His greatness shows in his care for the weak.

f.w: The LORD upholdeth all that fall

n: All creatures look hopefully to God, and he provides their food at the right time.

f.w: The eyes of all wait upon thee

n: He opens his hand and satisfies the needs of every living thing.

f.w: Thou openest thine hand

n: God is just in all his ways and kind in all he does.

f.w: holy in all his works
f.g: Or ‘loving’ — Hebrew ḥasid, faithful and kind.

n: The Lord is near to everyone who calls on him sincerely — ‘in truth,’ with honest intent.

f.w: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him
in truth

n: He fulfills the desires of those who revere him, hears their cry, and saves them.

f.w: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him

n: The Lord protects all who love him, but the wicked he will destroy.

f.w: preserveth all them that love him

n: David will keep praising, and he invites ‘all flesh’ — every living being — to bless God’s holy name forever. This sets up the great praise finale of Psalms 146–150.

f.w: let all flesh bless his holy name
